mapper.insert: insert into sys_subscribe (user_id, work_id, notify_enabled, created_at) select #{userId}, #{workId}, 1, now() from dual where not exists ( select 1 from sys_subscribe s where s.user_id = #{userId} and s.work_id = #{workId} )
mapper.select: select w.work_id, w.title, w.cover, w.episode_count, w.price, u.nick_name as author_name, s.notify_enabled, s.created_at from sys_subscribe s inner join sys_work w on w.work_id = s.work_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = w.author_id where s.user_id = #{userId} and w.is_deleted = 0 and w.status = 'on_shelf' order by s.created_at desc, s.id desc
